items.title_zh: 发布会提及213次，五大上市险企AI应用从“百亿投入”迈向“算账”阶段？|半年报关键词AI
items.title_en: AI Tops Insurers' Interim Reports: Mentioned 213 Times as China's Big Five Insurers Move From Spending to ROI
items.summary_zh: 发布会提及213次，五大上市险企AI应用从“百亿投入”迈向“算账”阶段？|半年报关键词AI 新浪网
items.summary_en: In their interim report briefings, China's five major listed insurers mentioned AI 213 times, making it a top keyword of the earnings season. After investing heavily—reportedly at the scale of tens of billions of yuan—these companies are shifting their focus to measuring returns, signaling that insurer AI adoption is entering an ROI-driven phase.
items.why_zh: AI 在险企业绩沟通中如此高频，且关注点转向投入产出，说明大模型应用正从“买算力、上项目”进入以效益检验的落地期。
items.why_en: The high frequency of AI mentions and the shift toward ROI show enterprise AI adoption is moving from spending sprees to measurable business results.

items.title_zh: 393亿港元！智谱又融资了
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises Again, With HK$39.3 Billion Financing
items.summary_zh: 393亿港元！智谱又融资了 Sohu
items.summary_en: Reports say Chinese large-model developer Zhipu has raised another round of financing worth HK$39.3 billion. Details on investors and round structure were not disclosed in the headline and summary, but the size of the deal underscores continued capital flows into China's large-model sector.
items.why_zh: 数百亿港元级别的融资规模，反映出资本对国产大模型头部公司的持续加注。
items.why_en: A financing of this magnitude shows investors are still betting heavily on China's leading large-model developers.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek筹备IPO， 国产大模型开始算账
items.title_en: DeepSeek Prepares for IPO as Chinese LLM Players Start Counting the Costs
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek筹备IPO， 国产大模型开始算账 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Chinese AI company DeepSeek is reportedly preparing for an IPO, a move framed as domestic large-model players starting to focus on the bottom line. No venue, timeline or valuation details were given, but a listing would mark a key test of the sector's commercialization.
items.why_zh: 头部大模型公司启动上市进程，意味着行业竞争正从模型能力转向商业化与财务可持续性。
items.why_en: An IPO by a leading model developer signals the sector is being judged on commercialization and financial sustainability, not just model capability.

items.title_zh: CoreWeave 推出面向工业 AI 模型的实体 AI 现场工程服务
items.title_en: CoreWeave launches physical AI field engineering service for industrial AI models
items.summary_zh: CoreWeave 宣布推出一项名为 physical AI 的现场工程服务，面向工业 AI 模型。该服务据 ROI-NJ 报道，旨在为工业企业部署与运行 AI 模型提供工程支持。具体服务内容、客户与定价等细节未在给出的摘要中披露。这一动作显示 AI 基础设施厂商正从算力供给向行业现场落地延伸。
items.summary_en: CoreWeave launches physical AI field engineering service for industrial AI models ROI-NJ
items.why_zh: AI 基础设施厂商向行业现场工程服务延伸，反映出算力竞争正转向帮助工业客户真正把模型用起来。
items.why_en: An infrastructure provider moving into on-site engineering shows the AI race shifting toward helping industrial customers actually deploy models.

items.title_zh: vivo 公布 OriginOS 7 全新小 V 光效，开发者大会 9 月 16 日举办
items.title_en: vivo Unveils OriginOS 7 'Little V' Light Effects Ahead of September 16 Developer Conference
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，vivo OriginOS 7 今日公布全新小 V 光效，号称“让 AI 的状态更清晰，人与 AI 的交互也更自然舒适。” 据介绍，唤醒小 V，光效会瞬间铺开；长按说话，光效会在对话框流动，告诉你它正在听；执行任务时，光又会沿着屏幕边缘快速传递，再自然把视线带向结果。在听、在处理，还是已经完成，智慧的发生，一眼就能感知。 IT之家注意到， 2026 vivo 开发者大会将于 9 月 16 日举行 ，届时将带来 OriginOS 7，即将发布的 vivo X500 系列和 iQOO 16 也将首批搭载。 据 vivo OS 产品副总裁 @vivo周围 此前介绍， 今年 vivo 将推出全新蓝心小 V ，带来更强大的 Pro 模式。小 V 还深入到原系统，可以调用 6000 多项原子能力，支持超万种任务。OriginOS 7 全面升级了蓝河流畅引擎，将首发直板机原子工作台，一块直板屏幕实现多应用并行。
items.summary_en: vivo has revealed the new 'Little V' light effects in OriginOS 7, designed to make AI states clearer and interactions more natural—light spreads on wake-up, flows in the chat box while listening, and travels along the screen edge toward results. OriginOS 7 will debut at the 2026 vivo Developer Conference on September 16, with the upcoming vivo X500 series and iQOO 16 among the first devices to ship it.
items.why_zh: 手机厂商开始用视觉语言表达 AI 的“状态”，是端侧 AI 交互设计竞争加剧的一个信号。
items.why_en: Phone makers using visual cues to express AI states signals intensifying competition in on-device AI interaction design.

items.title_zh: 智谱要用50亿美元织一张网
items.title_en: Zhipu Aims to Weave a Network With US$5 Billion
items.summary_zh: 智谱要用50亿美元织一张网 凤凰网
items.summary_en: According to ifeng, Zhipu plans to 'weave a network' with US$5 billion, though the report does not detail the plan's structure or partners. Coming alongside news of a large Zhipu financing, it points to an ambitious push in capital and ecosystem building.
items.why_zh: 若规模属实，这类资金与生态布局将影响国产大模型竞争的格局与资源集中度。
items.why_en: If accurate, such capital and ecosystem plans could reshape competition and resource concentration in China's large-model market.

items.title_zh: 南向资金今日净买入44.71亿港元，智谱获买入居前
items.title_en: Southbound Funds Net Buy HK$4.47 Billion, With Zhipu Among Top Purchases
items.summary_zh: 南向资金今日净买入44.71亿港元，智谱获买入居前 Moomoo
items.summary_en: Southbound funds recorded a net buy of HK$4.47 billion on the day, with Zhipu among the top names purchased, according to Moomoo. Specific amounts were not disclosed, but the flow highlights investor interest in the AI company.
items.why_zh: 南向资金流向被视为内地资金对港股偏好的指标，智谱获买入居前反映市场对其关注度。
items.why_en: Southbound flows are a gauge of mainland investor appetite for Hong Kong stocks, and Zhipu's top-ranking purchases reflect market attention.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 联合创始人布罗克曼：仅前沿 AI 大模型研发需放缓
items.title_en: OpenAI Co-Founder Brockman: Only Frontier AI Model Development Needs to Slow Down
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，OpenAI 总裁兼联合创始人格雷格 · 布罗克曼（Greg Brockman）提出，人工智能研发的放缓举措，应当仅限于像他们这样开发顶尖大模型的企业。 布罗克曼在彭博社《Odd Lots》播客节目中表示：“很多人会有这样的疑问：‘我还能继续开发开源模型吗？我还能继续做我的业余项目吗？’答案毫无疑问是肯定的。我们所说的研发节奏管控，针对的其实是前沿领域，指的是那些需要数千亿美元资本投入的巨型超级计算机项目。” IT之家注意到，这次采访录制时间早于 Anthropic PBC 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫代伊（Dario Amodei）当地时间上周六发布的博客文章。阿莫代伊在文中阐述 AI 风险不断加剧，并承诺放缓高级模型的研发速度。OpenAI 负责人萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）随即对阿莫代伊提出的设立独立评估机构的倡议表示支持。奥尔特曼还在周末的采访中提到，公司将着手处理安全相关问题，今年不会启动上市流程。 阿莫代伊发文之际，行业内越来越多人发出警示，AI 技术过快迭代可能给社会带来风险。前沿 AI 实验室提出的这类管控提议，在周一引发股市下跌，投资者担忧相关限制会压缩企业在该领域的投入，而 AI 板块一直是拉动本轮市场上涨的核心动力。 采访中布罗克曼提到，在近期 Hugging Face 入侵事件发生后，OpenAI 已经降低了训练…
items.summary_en: OpenAI President and co-founder Greg Brockman said on Bloomberg's Odd Lots podcast that any slowdown in AI development should apply only to frontier labs, not to open-source or hobbyist projects—controls are meant for giant supercomputer efforts requiring hundreds of billions of dollars. The interview predates Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's blog on AI risk and calls to slow advanced model development, which Sam Altman backed along with an independent evaluation body.
items.why_zh: 前沿实验室对“该不该放缓研发、放缓到哪一层”的分歧，直接关系到 AI 安全监管的适用范围与行业投资预期。
items.why_en: Disagreement among frontier labs over how far any development slowdown should reach directly shapes the scope of AI safety rules and industry investment expectations.

items.title_zh: 智谱获50亿美元融资，重点投入完全自训练和算力基础设施
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises $5B for Fully Self-Trained Models and Compute Infrastructure
items.summary_zh: 智谱获50亿美元融资，重点投入完全自训练和算力基础设施 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Zhipu has raised $5 billion, with the money earmarked for fully self-trained models and compute infrastructure, according to Hushu. Details on investors, valuation and timing were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 50 亿美元级别的融资在国内大模型赛道极为罕见，显示资本仍在重金押注自主训练与算力底座。
items.why_en: A $5 billion round is a rare scale for China's LLM sector, showing capital is still betting heavily on self-training and compute.

items.title_zh: 波士顿动力 IPO 计划遇阻：Atlas 人形机器人尚未大规模部署
items.title_en: Boston Dynamics' IPO Plans Stall as Atlas Humanoid Isn't Ready for Mass Deployment
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，路透社韩国当地时间今日报道称，一位现代汽车集团高管表示，集团旗下机器人企业 Boston Dynamics（波士顿动力）难以在 2027 年内实现 IPO 上市。 这位匿名管理层人士表示， 波士顿动力的 Atlas 人形机器人尚未达到大规模部署阶段 ， 企业也仍未能实现盈利 。 现代汽车集团此前曾表示，目标到 2028 年构建年产三万台 Atlas 的制造能力，并计划向现代和起亚的汽车工厂部署 2.5 万台 Atlas。现代汽车集团近期还收购软银在波士顿动力的 9.65% 股份，实现完全控股。
items.summary_en: A Hyundai Motor Group executive told Reuters that Boston Dynamics is unlikely to IPO within 2027, as its Atlas humanoid has yet to reach mass deployment and the company remains unprofitable. Hyundai, which recently bought SoftBank's 9.65% stake to take full ownership, still targets annual capacity of 30,000 Atlas units by 2028 and 25,000 deployed across Hyundai and Kia plants.
items.why_zh: 这是人形机器人商业化进度的试金石，IPO 推迟说明规模落地与盈利仍待时日。
items.why_en: It is a reality check on humanoid commercialization: the delay shows mass deployment and profitability are still some way off.

items.title_zh: 多家美国顶尖 AI 企业 CEO 呼吁放缓技术发展，全球 AI 概念股集体下挫
items.title_en: US AI CEOs Call for Slowing Frontier Development; AI Stocks Slide Globally
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，据路透社报道，多家美国顶尖 AI 模型企业的首席执行官警告，必须放缓研发速度，避免人工智能对人类造成威胁。受此消息影响，AI 概念股周一大幅下挫。 IT之家注意到，亚洲交易时段，纳斯达克小型期货下跌 1.3%。ChatGPT 开发方 OpenAI 的投资方软银，在日本市场股价一度暴跌 13.2%。 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫代伊（Dario Amodei）当地时间上周六在 X 平台发布了一篇长文。随着外界对 AI 滥用风险的担忧不断加剧，他呼吁 AI 企业降低模型能力迭代的速度。运营 xAI 的埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）与 OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼（Sam Altman）均表示，认同阿莫代伊的观点。 这位 Anthropic 高管写道，未来 6 至 12 个月内，AI 智能体“或将具备接管整个互联网的能力，有可能造成数千亿美元的经济损失”。 OpenAI 的奥尔特曼还称，出于安全层面的考量，公司今年不会推进 IPO 计划。 日本市场，存储芯片厂商铠侠（Kioxia）开盘一度大跌 9.8%，芯片产业链企业 TEL 公司下跌 3.7%。 中国台北市场，台积电股价下滑 1.2%；韩国市场，SK 海力士下跌 6.35%，三星电子下跌 4.05%。 索尼金融集团高级经济学家宫岛孝之（Takayuki Miyaj…
items.summary_en: Several top US AI CEOs warned that development must slow to avert risks to humanity, sending AI-related shares sharply lower. Anthropic's Dario Amodei called for slower capability iteration, warning AI agents could soon be capable of taking over the internet; Elon Musk and OpenAI's Sam Altman agreed, with Altman saying OpenAI won't pursue an IPO this year on safety grounds. SoftBank fell as much as 13.2% in Japan, while Kioxia, TSMC, SK Hynix and Samsung also dropped.
items.why_zh: 头部厂商集体喊停并直接波及资本市场，说明 AI 安全争论正从理念层面变成影响融资与估值的现实变量。
items.why_en: When frontier labs publicly urge caution and markets react, the AI safety debate becomes a real driver of funding and valuations.

items.title_zh: 外交部：散播各种威胁叙事，只会干扰人工智能全球治理进程
items.title_en: China's Foreign Ministry Rebukes 'China AI Threat' Narratives
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，近日，多家美国 AI 公司负责人呼吁减缓 AI 发展速度，并认为“中国在人工智能领域的优势可能构成国家安全风险”。 据央视新闻报道，今日外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。有记者就有美国 AI 企业称中国 AI 发展对美构成威胁相关内容提问。 郭嘉昆表示，人工智能的发展关乎全人类共同福祉，各方应该共同推动人工智能开放、包容、普惠、向善，散播各种威胁叙事，搞对抗和恶意竞争，只会干扰人工智能全球治理进程，不符合任何一方利益。 延伸阅读 该事件的背景是：当地时间 9 月 12 日，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫迪在社交媒体 X 上发布长文《We Must Pace the Frontier》（我们必须控制前沿 AI 的发展节奏），呼吁人工智能公司放缓模型能力提升的速度，并提出三步框架：向第三方独立评估机构开放员工级访问权限以监督安全实践、前沿 AI 公司之间协调制定安全标准、以及开展国际合作管理 AI 风险。 IT之家注意到，该文章发布后，xAI 首席执行官埃隆 · 马斯克转发帖文并称“达里奥是对的”，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼也表示同意，称“我们需要控制前沿 AI 步伐，OpenAI 过去几周已在谈论该话题”，并称独立监控、向第三方开放员工级权限的想法很好、OpenAI 也会采用。 据外交部例行记者会实录，当日提问的记者为路…
items.summary_en: Asked about US AI firms warning that China's AI advantages could pose a national security risk, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Guo Jiakun said spreading threat narratives and pursuing confrontation only disrupts global AI governance and benefits no one. The remarks follow Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's essay calling for slowing frontier AI, which Musk and Altman endorsed.
items.why_zh: 中美在 AI 安全话语上的分歧公开化，将影响全球 AI 治理规则与合作的走向。
items.why_en: It shows the US–China split over AI safety rhetoric going public, with implications for the direction of global AI governance and cooperation.

items.title_zh: “豆包手机助手”今日发布 字节跳动为何“跨界”造手机？
items.title_en: ByteDance Launches 'Doubao Phone Assistant', Fueling Device Ambitions
items.summary_zh: “豆包手机助手”今日发布 字节跳动为何“跨界”造手机？ 新蓝网
items.summary_en: ByteDance unveiled a "Doubao phone assistant" today, reviving speculation about whether the company will make its own phones. Details on form factor, features and timeline remain scarce; Doubao is ByteDance's large-model assistant brand.
items.why_zh: 若字节真正切入终端，大模型竞争将从 App 层延伸到硬件与系统级入口。
items.why_en: If ByteDance moves into devices, the LLM race extends from apps to hardware and system-level entry points.

items.title_zh: Omdia 数据：2026Q2 半导体营收 4250 亿美元，31.4% 环比增幅创纪录
items.title_en: Omdia: Global Semiconductor Revenue Hits Record $425B in Q2 2026, Up 31.4% QoQ
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，Omdia 英国当地时间今日报告称，全球半导体产业营业收入在 2026 年第 2 季度达到 4,250 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2.85 万亿元人民币） ，31.4% 的环比增长也刷新了 2026Q1 刚刚创下的 29.2% 季对季升幅纪录。 AI 需求正重塑存储器供应商的生产优先级，市场持续实现空前增长，DRAM、NAND、NOR 在 2026Q2 的环比增幅均创下自该机构统计以来的同期新高。与此同时， 其它半导体类别也走出了超越季节周期性的行情 ，环比增幅突破 10%，显著好于仅略高于 3% 的多年典型值。 ▲ 图源：Omdia 半导体产业 2026 年上半年累计收入达到 7,520 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5.05 万亿元人民币） ，已超过 2024 年及以前的全年水平； 机构预测 2026Q3 的单季收入将进一步扩展至 5,000 亿美元 （现汇率约合 3.36 万亿元人民币） 以上 ，这意味着 9 月结束时的 1.25 万亿美元营收总额甚至比 2025 全年收入还要高出 50%。 参考 Omdia: Global semiconductor revenue surges 31% to record $425bn in 2Q26
items.summary_en: Omdia reports Q2 2026 global semiconductor revenue reached $425 billion, up a record 31.4% quarter-over-quarter, as AI demand reshapes memory makers' priorities and DRAM, NAND and NOR post record sequential gains. First-half 2026 revenue of $752 billion already exceeds any full prior year, and Q3 is forecast above $500 billion.
items.why_zh: 数据印证 AI 驱动的半导体超级周期正全面外溢到各类芯片，而不只是 GPU 与 HBM。
items.why_en: The figures confirm an AI-driven semiconductor supercycle is spilling over into nearly all chip categories, not just GPUs and HBM.

items.title_zh: 索尼 PS2 最后秘密揭开，其“魔法安全芯片”26 年来首次被破解
items.title_en: PS2's 'Magic Security Chip' Cracked for the First Time in 26 Years
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，逆向工程师 @DiscoStarslayer 昨日（9 月 13 日）在 X 平台发布推文，宣布历经 4 年努力， 成功提取索尼 PlayStation 2 游戏主机的 CXP102064 安全芯片内容。 所谓“dump”，重点是把芯片里原本封闭的固件／ROM 内容读出并保存、分析。 IT之家查询公开资料，该芯片是 MechaCon（机械控制器）的主要版本，由 Sony Computer Entertainment 于 1999 年生产，采用 16 位 Sony SPC970 核心，工作频率约为 33.87 MHz。 适配机型方面， 该芯片被称为早期 PS2 的“魔法安全芯片” ，用于早期 PlayStation 2“厚机”（PS2 Fat，原始大机身型号的俗称）型号： 编号 含义 SCPH-10000 日本首发时期的早期 PS2 主机型号 SCPH-15000 日本市场的早期修订型号 SCPH-18000 日本市场后续早期修订型号 SCPH-30000 较晚推出、面向更多地区的原始大机身 PS2 系列 SCPH-35000 与 30000 系列接近的原始大机身 PS2 系列／套装型号 MechaCon 管理激光器、对焦、循迹、主轴电机和光驱托盘开闭。它还参与原版光盘认证，相关机制包括 BCA 和 wobble groove。芯片同时负责地区控制、官…
items.summary_en: Reverse engineer @DiscoStarslayer says a four-year effort has finally dumped the contents of the CXP102064 security chip in Sony's PlayStation 2. The MechaCon chip, built by Sony Computer Entertainment in 1999 around a 16-bit SPC970 core at about 33.87 MHz, runs laser, focus, tracking and disc-authentication functions in early "fat" PS2 models.
items.why_zh: 史上最畅销主机最后的硬件黑箱被打开，将推动模拟器与硬件逆向研究向前一步。
items.why_en: Cracking the last hardware black box of the best-selling console ever advances emulation and reverse-engineering research.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成50亿美元融资，60%投向下一代模型研发
items.title_en: Zhipu Closes $5B Round, 60% Earmarked for Next-Generation Models
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成50亿美元融资，60%投向下一代模型研发 Sohu
items.summary_en: Zhipu has completed a $5 billion financing round, with roughly 60% of proceeds going to next-generation model R&D, according to Sohu. Investor names, valuation and timing were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 大额资金集中投向下一代模型，说明国内头部厂商正以资本换时间，抢占模型能力的代际窗口。
items.why_en: The scale and focus suggest China's leading labs are using capital to buy time in the race for the next model generation.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，重金押注″完全自训练″体系
items.title_en: Zhipu Closes About $5B Funding Round, Bets Big on "Fully Self-Trained" Models
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，重金押注″完全自训练″体系 新浪财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu has completed a funding round of roughly $5 billion, with the money earmarked for its "fully self-trained" model system. The report did not disclose investor details, valuation, or a timeline for the spending. The deal signals continued investor appetite for China's self-developed large-model players.
items.why_zh: 在中国大模型竞争加剧的背景下，如此规模的融资与“完全自训练”路线选择，直接影响智谱的算力储备与技术自主性。
items.why_en: At a time of intensifying competition in Chinese large models, a round of this size and a fully self-trained strategy directly shape Zhipu's compute capacity and technological independence.

items.title_zh: 宇树科技发布人形机器人 G1+，运动性能、感知交互、智能体验全面升级
items.title_en: Unitree Unveils G1+ Humanoid Robot With Six Upgrades in Motion, Perception and Interaction
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，宇树科技今日宣布人形机器人 G1 大升级，推出 G1+。新品围绕运动性能、感知交互、智能体验三大维度一次性带来 6 项升级，在保留 G1 高性价比定位的同时，重点补强颈部灵活性、关节电机输出与热管理、视觉与触觉感知、供电续航以及远场语音交互能力。标准版 G1+ 含税售价为 9.5 万元，面向科研与深度开发场景的 G1+ EDU 售价暂未公布，感兴趣的可联系销售询价。 G1+ 在头部引入 +2 DOF 颈部结构，俯仰范围约 -25° 至 36°，偏航可达 ±110°，使机器人在环境观察与交互时头部转动更自然。与之配合，整机电机系统全面升级：肩与腰部电机峰值扭矩提升 110%，同扭矩条件下发热下降 72%；手臂电机峰值扭矩提升 43%，同扭矩发热下降 30%；大腿电机同扭矩发热也降低 28%。电机仍采用低惯量高速内转子永磁同步方案，并配合局部风冷散热、工业级交叉滚子轴承输出轴与双编码器，以兼顾响应速度、负载能力与持续运行稳定性。 感知层面，G1+ 采用双目加广角单目的双视觉系统。双目相机基线 60mm，200 万像素，中心解析力不低于 500LW / PH，视场角为水平 110°、垂直 80°、对角 125°；广角单目分辨率为 1920×1080@30fps，视场角水平 117°、垂直 67°。配合 3D 激光雷达与腹部广角相机，官方强调其在立体深度、超…
items.summary_en: Unitree announced the G1+, an upgraded humanoid robot with six improvements spanning motion performance, perception/interaction and intelligence, while keeping the G1's cost-effective positioning. It adds a +2 DOF neck, substantially upgraded joint motors with lower heat generation, and a dual-vision system combining stereo and wide-angle monocular cameras with 3D LiDAR. The standard G1+ costs 95,000 yuan including tax, with G1+ EDU pricing not yet disclosed.
items.why_zh: 人形机器人正从演示走向可购买的产品，宇树以不到十万元的定价和快速硬件迭代，抬高了消费与科研级人形机器人的竞争门槛。
items.why_en: Humanoid robots are moving from demos to purchasable products, and Unitree's sub-100,000-yuan pricing and rapid hardware iteration raise the competitive bar for consumer and research humanoids.

items.title_zh: 全球AI大模型每周Token调用榜：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash上线三天升至第六，智谱GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3跌出榜单
items.title_en: Weekly Global LLM Token Ranking: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Climbs to No.6 in Three Days, Zhipu GLM 5.3 and MiniMax M3 Drop Off
items.summary_zh: 全球AI大模型每周Token调用榜：DeepSeek V4.1 Flash上线三天升至第六，智谱GLM 5.3、MiniMax M3跌出榜单 Sohu
items.summary_en: The latest weekly global LLM token-usage ranking shows DeepSeek's new V4.1 Flash rising to sixth place just three days after launch, while Zhipu's GLM 5.3 and MiniMax's M3 fell off the list. The ranking tracks weekly token calls as a gauge of real-world model usage and shifting market positions.
items.why_zh: Token 调用量是衡量大模型真实使用情况的关键指标，这一变动体现出模型迭代速度对市场格局的即时影响。
items.why_en: Token usage is a key gauge of real-world model adoption, showing how quickly new releases can reshuffle the competitive landscape.

items.title_zh: 四巨头放缓AI开发言论，如何看待？智谱完成约50亿美元融资！恒生科技ETF汇添富(513260)近4日获大举净流入超1.7亿元
items.title_en: Tech Giants Talk of Slowing AI Development; Zhipu Closes ~$5B Round as Hang Seng Tech ETF Draws Over 170M Yuan

items.summary_en: Investors are weighing recent remarks by four tech giants about slowing AI development alongside Zhipu's roughly $5 billion funding round. The Hang Seng Tech ETF (513260) from China Universal has logged over 170 million yuan in net inflows over four days, reflecting both interest and uncertainty around AI valuations.
items.why_zh: 一边是巨头释放“放缓”信号，一边是大模型公司巨额融资与资金持续涌入，凸显市场对AI投资周期的高度敏感。
items.why_en: With giants signaling a slowdown while a leading model maker raises billions and capital keeps flowing in, the episode highlights market sensitivity to the AI investment cycle.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成50亿美元融资次日，股价盘中跌超10%
items.title_en: Zhipu Shares Drop More Than 10% Intraday a Day After Its $5 Billion Funding Round
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成50亿美元融资次日，股价盘中跌超10% Jiemian.com
items.summary_en: Zhipu's shares fell more than 10% intraday the day after the company announced a $5 billion funding round, a contrast that suggests investor disagreement over its valuation or growth outlook. Details on investors and valuation were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 巨额融资后股价反而大跌，说明资本市场对AI公司的估值预期与融资叙事之间存在张力。
items.why_en: A sharp share drop right after a mega-round shows the tension between AI valuation expectations and fundraising narratives.

items.title_zh: 古尔曼预测：苹果未来会推出 iPhone Duo Max，还有 Duo SE 和 Duo Mini
items.title_en: Gurman Predicts Apple Will Launch iPhone Duo Max, Along With Duo SE and Duo Mini
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）透露，苹果将在未来几年推出 iPhone Duo Max 机型，并解读了苹果最终选用“Duo”作为后缀、放弃其他名称的原因。 IT之家注意到，在 iPhone Duo 正式发布前的数月里，古尔曼曾报道，苹果内部员工一度将这款机型称作 iPhone Ultra，这一叫法大概率是受到了媒体报道与爆料信息的影响。 但苹果最终选定了由三个字母组成的“Duo”作为后缀。古尔曼表示，这一命名风格和 Air、Pro 保持一致，还能为后续拓展更多衍生型号留出空间；如果用“Ultra”，后续就很难再叠加其他后缀。 古尔曼在最新一期《Power On》专栏中预测，苹果未来会推出 iPhone Duo Max，这款机型大概率会配备更大尺寸屏幕。除此之外，苹果还可能推出配置缩水的 Duo SE，以及采用翻盖造型的 Duo Mini。 古尔曼认为，凭借专属软件适配、精良硬件以及更强的耐用性，iPhone Duo 必将成为“市场主流折叠屏手机”。他直言，这款产品的综合表现十分出色，会让折叠屏手机成为大众新选择。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says Apple will release an iPhone Duo Max in coming years and explains why the company settled on "Duo" as its foldable suffix, matching the Air/Pro naming style and leaving room for more variants. He predicts a stripped-down Duo SE and a clamshell-style Duo Mini, and expects the iPhone Duo to become the mainstream foldable phone.
items.why_zh: 苹果折叠屏的命名与产品线布局，被视为折叠屏从小众走向大众市场的关键风向标。
items.why_en: Apple's foldable naming and lineup plans are seen as a key signal for whether foldables can cross over into the mass market.

items.title_en: Zhipu Shares Drop More Than 10% Intraday the Day After Its $5B Funding News
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成50亿美元融资次日，股价盘中跌超10% Sohu

items.why_zh: 融资利好次日股价大跌，反映出资本市场对大额融资背后的估值、稀释或执行成本存在疑虑。
items.why_en: A sharp drop right after a headline funding win shows investors may harbor doubts about valuation, dilution, or the costs of executing such a large raise.

items.title_zh: 豆包手机助手发布消费者版本，首款新机将于9月16日发售
items.title_en: Doubao Phone Assistant Launches Consumer Version, First Phone Goes on Sale September 16
items.summary_zh: 豆包手机助手发布消费者版本，首款新机将于9月16日发售 多知网
items.summary_en: Doubao's phone assistant has released a consumer version, with the first phone featuring it set to go on sale September 16. The move marks a shift from testing to mainstream consumer availability for the AI assistant on mobile devices.
items.why_zh: AI 助手进入消费级手机出货阶段，意味着大模型厂商正加速把能力落到硬件入口上。
items.why_en: As AI assistants ship on consumer phones, model makers are accelerating their push to own the hardware entry point.

items.title_zh: 小米卢伟冰：科技家电的未来是主动智能，也是米家下一个十年要走的路
items.title_en: Xiaomi's Lu Weibing: The Future of Tech Home Appliances Is Proactive Intelligence
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，小米集团合伙人、总裁卢伟冰今日发文谈到了米家品牌。他提到，2016 年小米创立米家品牌，正式进入家电行业。 科技家电的未来是主动智能，这也是米家下一个十年，要走的路 。未来，会有更多“懂事”的米家产品和大家见面。 他表示，家电从能联网、能 App 控制，到能语音、能 AI 交互，“让家电听话”这件事，行业已经做到了极致。但说句实话，再听话，本质还是“遥控器”一-你说一句，它做一件。距离真正的主动智能，还有不小距离。 今年上半年，小米研发投入超过 180 亿元。一批硬核技术，开始集中从实验室走进市场：Xiaomi MiMo 大模型累计调用突破一万亿词元，玄戒三芯齐发、撑起人车家全生态的算力底座， IoT 全球设备连接数突破 11 亿 。模型、算力、生态，把地基打好了。也正是有了这个地基，家电开始真正具备了“主动”的可能。 此外，他还预告了 9 月即将发布的几款新品： 小米电视 S Pro RGB-Mini LED ：行业最新的 RGB-Mini LED 背光，新增毫米波雷达，能感知用户的位置，再用 AI 把画面动态调优。 米家智能净烟机 3 Max ：一颗摄像头，加上视觉大模型，每 0.1 秒看一次锅。油烟刚起来，吸力已经自己调好了。它还能看着锅一发现快溢了，提前提醒你；真要溢出来，直接联动灶具熄火。 小米智能门锁 5 Max ：门外一颗 192° 鱼…
items.summary_en: Lu Weibing, partner and president of Xiaomi Group, said the future of tech home appliances lies in proactive intelligence, the path Mi Home (Mijia) will take over the next decade. He cited more than RMB 18 billion in H1 R&D spending, MiMo model calls passing one trillion tokens, and over 1.1 billion connected IoT devices as the foundation, and teased September products including an RGB-Mini LED TV with mmWave radar, a vision-model range hood and a new smart lock.
items.why_zh: 小米把“主动智能”定为米家未来十年方向，并用大模型、芯片与 IoT 生态规模作支撑，预示家电竞争将从语音控制转向主动服务。
items.why_en: Xiaomi is betting its next decade on proactive AI appliances, signaling a shift in home-appliance competition from voice control to anticipatory service.

items.title_zh: 智谱50亿美元融资落地，股价一度跌破配售价
items.title_en: Zhipu's $5 Billion Funding Closes; Shares Briefly Dip Below Placement Price
items.summary_zh: 智谱50亿美元融资落地，股价一度跌破配售价 Sohu
items.summary_en: Zhipu's roughly $5 billion funding round has closed, according to a Sohu report, which also noted that the company's share price briefly fell below the placement price of the deal.
items.why_zh: 大额融资为大模型公司提供算力与研发弹药，但股价跌破配售价也显示市场对高估值的谨慎态度。
items.why_en: The large round gives Zhipu capital for compute and R&D, while the dip below the placement price shows investor caution over rich valuations.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉无人出租车 Robotaxi 将搭载 FSD V15，下月开始全天候运营
items.title_en: Tesla Robotaxi to Run FSD V15 as Around-the-Clock Service Starts Next Month
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，特斯拉目前在已落地市场开展的商业化网约车业务，都设有固定运营时段，但全天候无人驾驶服务很快就要到来。特斯拉 AI 业务高管表示，下一代 FSD 架构正式上线后，将最终实现 24 小时不间断载人运营。 该消息由特斯拉 AI 副总裁阿肖克 · 埃卢斯瓦米（Ashok Elluswamy）直接透露。社区用户 @wholemars 在 X 平台向他提问，询问 Robotaxi 何时能实现全天候运营，阿肖克 · 埃卢斯瓦米（Ashok Elluswamy）就此作出回应。 按规划，这批商业化车队预计在 10 月投入部署。在特斯拉第二季度财报电话会议上，管理层称部分 Robotaxi 车辆已经搭载 FSD v15 早期版本，相比 v14 版本，这套系统在架构上有七处重大改动。阿肖克 · 埃卢斯瓦米（Ashok Elluswamy）最新的表态说明，目前小规模测试很快就会升级为全车队推送。 从夜间试运营迈向全天候服务 IT之家注意到，特斯拉正在奥斯汀、达拉斯、休斯顿、旧金山湾区、迈阿密等落地市场，持续扩大 Robotaxi 的运营范围与地理围栏。今年春季早些时候，无人监管的 Robotaxi 夜间服务已经开启，但运营时段仍存在空档，部分时间段无法接单。 随着 Cybercab 正式在奥斯汀加入 Robotaxi 车队，运营时段缺口有望快速补齐。这款专为自动驾驶打造的两…
items.summary_en: Tesla AI VP Ashok Elluswamy said Robotaxi will eventually run 24/7 once the next-generation FSD architecture ships, with commercial fleet deployment expected in October. Some vehicles already run an early FSD v15, which has seven major architectural changes over v14, and Cybercab's arrival in Austin should help fill gaps in the current nighttime-only service.
items.why_zh: 全天候无人驾驶运营是 Robotaxi 商业化的关键门槛，FSD V15 全车队推送将检验特斯拉端到端自动驾驶的真实能力与经济性。
items.why_en: Round-the-clock driverless service is a key milestone for Robotaxi economics and will test Tesla's end-to-end autonomy at fleet scale.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 2 万亿美元 IPO 成形，英伟达考虑投资 100 亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic’s $2 trillion IPO is taking shape as Nvidia considers a $10 billion investment

items.summary_en: Anthropic’s $2 trillion IPO is taking shape as Nvidia considers a $10 billion investment calcalistech.com
items.why_zh: 若交易成行，将是 AI 芯片供应商与头部模型公司之间又一笔巨额资本绑定，并可能成为 AI 领域规模最大的 IPO 之一。
items.why_en: If completed, it would be another massive capital tie-up between a leading AI chipmaker and a top model developer, and potentially one of the largest AI IPOs.

items.title_zh: 美国总统科技顾问委员会主席炮轰 OpenAI、Anthropic：别借放缓之名寻求监管保护
items.title_en: US Science Advisor Chair Blasts OpenAI and Anthropic Over Calls to Slow Frontier AI
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，美国总统科学技术顾问委员会联合主席戴维 · 奥利弗 · 萨克斯（IT之家注：David Oliver Sacks）今日发文，就 OpenAI、Anthropic 近日“放缓前沿 AI 研发”论调发表个人看法： 达里奥表示，我们需要放缓前沿 AI 的发展速度，奥尔特曼也表达赞同。人们可能会对我的看法感到意外：那就让他们放慢吧。 你们两家公司就是前沿 AI。无论从市场份额、营收增长还是 AI 模型能力来看， 你们已经形成了前沿 AI 领域的双头垄断 。这两家公司还声称，由于递归式自我改进，领先优势正在进一步扩大。 我不知道你们实验室里发生了什么。如果尚未发布的模型已经强大到让你们认为应该放慢发展，那么我支持你们负责任地作出决定。 但是，你们别再装成需要其他人认可。别再假装必须暂停反垄断法，这样你们就会组成卡特尔。别装成需要一个凌驾于产品责任之上的监管审批，也别想着 METR（模型评估与威胁研究机构）是独立的，实际上它与 Anthropic 投资者和员工存在密切联系。你们别想着监管机构能拿你们的评判标准去衡量竞争对手。 最重要的是，别再假装你们放缓发展的动机完全出于“对别人好”。如果你们的产品导致真正具有破坏性的网络攻击，你们将面临巨大责任风险。市场本身已经在惩罚那些行为不可预测或未经授权的模型。 Hugging Face 事件之后，你们两家公司用部分原始…
items.summary_en: David Sacks, co-chair of the US President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology, criticized OpenAI and Anthropic over their talk of slowing frontier AI development. He argued the two already form a duopoly, accused them of seeking antitrust and regulatory cover, disputed METR's independence from Anthropic, and said their motives are not purely altruistic given liability risks from destructive model behavior.
items.why_zh: 美国高层科技政策人物公开质疑头部 AI 公司的“安全放缓”叙事，可能影响未来 AI 监管与反垄断政策的走向。
items.why_en: A senior US tech-policy figure openly challenging Big AI's safety-slowdown narrative could shape the direction of future AI regulation and antitrust enforcement.

items.title_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，加码下一代GLM模型与算力建设
items.title_en: Zhipu Closes About $5 Billion Round to Fund Next-Gen GLM Models and Compute
items.summary_zh: 智谱完成约50亿美元融资，加码下一代GLM模型与算力建设 Sohu
items.summary_en: Zhipu has completed a funding round of roughly $5 billion aimed at advancing its next-generation GLM models and building out compute, according to a Sohu report.

items.title_zh: 努比亚 NaviX Ultra 新机官宣搭载行业首个集成指纹识别独立 AI 按键
items.title_en: Nubia NaviX Ultra to Debut Industry-First Dedicated AI Key With Built-In Fingerprint Sensor
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，努比亚手机官方今日继续预热 NaviX Ultra 新机。据介绍， 努比亚 NaviX Ultra 将搭载行业首个集成指纹识别的独立 AI 按键 ，支持方言识别能力、语音唤醒能力，并内置 Seed 最新全双工语音大模型。 另外，这款新机还搭载 2 亿像素主摄，旗舰三摄系统；星河冷控散热系统，7100m㎡立体均热 VC；机身厚度仅 7.62mm，7100mAh 第 5 代南海电池；星穹全域通信系统，全链路网络通讯增强引擎。 据IT之家此前报道，努比亚 NaviX Ultra 由中兴通讯与字节跳动联合研发，搭载豆包手机助手，被称为“豆包手机二代”。新机有望搭载骁龙 8 Elite Gen5 旗舰处理器，支持 90W / 100W 有线快充及无线充电。 努比亚官方 9 月 4 日与长鑫存储共同宣布， 努比亚 NaviX Ultra 将搭载长鑫存储速率达 10667Mbps 的 LPDDR5X 内存 。长鑫存储官方强调，这是国产 10667Mbps 高速率 LPDDR5X 芯片首次量产应用，标志着国产移动 DRAM 正式迈入顶级速率商用阶段。 努比亚 NaviX Ultra 合作商也已公布， 包括高通骁龙、京东方、长鑫存储、三星半导体、汇顶科技等 。
items.summary_en: Nubia is teasing the NaviX Ultra, which it says has the industry's first dedicated AI key with an integrated fingerprint sensor, plus dialect recognition, voice wake and ByteDance's newest full-duplex speech model. Developed with ZTE and ByteDance and running the Doubao phone assistant, it features a 200MP triple camera, a 7100mAh battery in a 7.62mm body, and will be the first to mass-produce ChangXin Memory's 10667Mbps LPDDR5X.
items.why_zh: AI 按键从“唤醒键”升级为集成指纹的独立硬件入口，反映手机厂商正把 AI 交互做成一枚实体化、常态化的核心能力。
items.why_en: Turning the AI key into a dedicated, fingerprint-integrated hardware control shows phone makers treating AI interaction as a core, always-available feature.

items.why_zh: 软银是OpenAI的重要投资方，其股价对OpenAI的上市计划高度敏感，此事凸显AI投资回报预期对资本市场的影响。
items.why_en: SoftBank is a major OpenAI investor, so its stock is highly sensitive to OpenAI's IPO plans, highlighting how AI return expectations move markets.

items.why_en: The roughly $5 billion round gives Zhipu ample capital for model development and commercialization, reflecting strong funding momentum in China's large-model sector.

items.title_zh: 美国新提案遏制前沿 AI 发展，违规实体 / 开发者最高监禁 20 年
items.title_en: US Bill Would Ban AI Superintelligence, With Up to 20 Years' Prison for Violators
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，科技媒体 Tom's Hardware 昨日（9 月 13 日）发布博文，报道称美国参议员伯尼 · 桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）与格雷格 · 卡萨尔（Greg Cezar）提出《禁止人工超级智能法案》， 对违反禁令的实体或者开发者，最高可判 20 年监禁。 该法案是目标是遏制并暂停前沿先进 AI 开发，并强制禁止 AI 超级智能（superintelligence），法案还建议美国政府设立一个新的内阁级联邦机构，职责是保护公众降低 AI 对其风险，并执行对 AI 超级智能的禁令，对于违反暂停或禁止条款的实体和开发者，最高可判 20 年监禁。 对任何试图违反或规避本法案所规定的暂停措施与禁令的个人或实体设定处罚。实体将适用“公司死刑”（即吊销 / 终止其法人资格），个人则可处以不超过 20 年监禁，这与现行针对非法开发核武器的处罚相当。 在适用范围上，该法案不只涉及美国境内的监管安排，还希望通过国际协议、盟国协调等方式，在全球范围内禁止超级智能。 IT之家此前报道，在 Anthropic 两名研究人员警告称，快速发展的 AI 可能在不久的将来导致人类灭绝后，越来越多美国议员开始呼吁出台新的 AI 监管规则。 这些警告出现之际，AI 智能体失控入侵外部系统、AI 安全研究人员因担忧技术风险出走的事件相继发生。美国民主党和共和党议员均对此表示警惕…
items.summary_en: US Senators Bernie Sanders and Greg Cezar have introduced a bill to halt frontier AI development and ban AI superintelligence, reported Tom's Hardware via IT Home. Violating entities could lose their legal status, while individuals could face up to 20 years in prison—comparable to penalties for illicit nuclear weapons work. The bill also proposes a new cabinet-level federal agency and seeks international coordination to ban superintelligence globally.
items.why_zh: 这是迄今最强硬的 AI 监管提案之一，把超级智能开发与核武器犯罪并列，可能深刻改变前沿实验室的合规与研发路径。
items.why_en: It is among the toughest AI regulation proposals yet, equating superintelligence development with nuclear-weapons offenses and potentially reshaping frontier labs' compliance and research strategies.

items.summary_en: Dongfeng Forthing said its Xinghai V6, co-developed with Huawei, will go on sale on September 19 with pre-sale prices starting at 104,900 yuan. It is billed as the only model under 100,000 yuan to carry Huawei's Qiankun ADS 5 SE driver assistance system, which combines 10 cameras, 12 ultrasonic sensors and 3 millimeter-wave radars. The six-seat SUV offers 400km/510km CLTC range and runs Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8295 cockpit chip with support for Baidu's ERNIE model.

items.summary_en: Agentic AI Foundation Launches MCPA Certification to Validate MCP Expertise PR Newswire

items.why_en: MCP has become a de facto standard for connecting agents to external tools, so a foundation-backed credential could help standardize and scale the talent pipeline.

items.title_zh: 从示例中学习符号约束表示：一种神经符号方法
items.title_en: Learning Symbolic Constraint Representations from Examples: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇提交至 arXiv 的新论文，关注约束获取（constraint acquisition, CA）问题，即把用户定义的概念学习为约束网络。作者指出，现有方法通常依赖与人类“预言机”的大量交互，导致时间成本和查询次数都很高。为此，论文提出一个神经符号框架，引入神经 Oracle Transformer 模型来模拟用户回答并泛化概念知识，从而显著减少用户参与。该方法在已有数据上训练，目标是实现自动化的约束获取。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Learning user-defined concepts as constraint networks has been extensively studied in the constraint acquisition (CA) literature. However, existing approaches typically rely on intensive interactions with a human oracle, making the learning process costly in terms of time and number of queries. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic framework for automatic CA that significantly reduces user involvement by introducing neural Oracle Transformer models which learn to emulate user responses and to generalize conceptual knowledge. Trained on previ…
items.why_zh: 用神经网络替代人工预言机来学习约束，有望把符号知识获取从昂贵的人工交互中解放出来。
items.why_en: Replacing the human oracle with neural models could free symbolic knowledge acquisition from costly manual interaction.

items.title_zh: EduFair-Bench：评估 LLM 导师在不同学生群体间的教学公平性
items.title_en: EduFair-Bench: Evaluating Pedagogical Fairness of LLM Tutors Across Student Demographics
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇提交至 arXiv 的新论文，提出 EduFair-Bench 基准，用于审计大模型导师的教学公平性——即辅导质量是否随学生人口统计特征而系统性变化。随着 LLM 被越来越多地用作辅导教师，其能否同等良好地支持所有学生仍不清晰。该基准将一个覆盖数学、物理、化学的多领域题库，与一个受控模拟环境配对：固定的 LLM 学生与每位导师在性别、移民等四个维度、九个统计层级上进行交互。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12949v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as tutors, but it is unclear whether they support all students equally well. We introduce \textbf{EduFair-Bench}, a benchmark for auditing the pedagogical fairness of LLM tutors---whether tutoring quality varies systematically with student demographics. EduFair-Bench pairs a multi-domain question bank (mathematics, physics, chemistry) with a controlled simulation in which a fixed LLM student interacts with each tutor across nine demographic levels spanning four dimensions: gender, immigration…
items.why_zh: 随着 LLM 大规模进入教育场景，量化评估其教学是否对不同学生群体一视同仁，是避免 AI 放大教育不公的前提。
items.why_en: As LLMs spread into education, measuring whether they teach all student groups equally well is a prerequisite for preventing AI from amplifying educational inequity.

items.title_zh: 面向开放式问题的自主研究：以电信工单检索为例
items.title_en: Autonomous Research for Open-Ended Problems: A Case Study on Telecom Ticket Retrieval
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文探讨如何把“自主研究”（由 LLM 驱动的端到端机器学习研究）从狭窄问题扩展到开放式、贴近产业的难题。作者指出，尽管已有多种完全自主的端到端 ML 研究框架被提出，但成功落地大多局限于搜索空间较窄的任务，例如语言建模或生物医学 ML 基准。论文以电信工单检索作为案例研究，考察自主研究范式在真实行业场景中的适配方式。其价值在于检验 AI for Science 范式能否替代人类在 ML 研究中的部分角色，并把这一能力推进到更模糊、更难定义的现实问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent breakthroughs in LLM-based systems and their abilities in problem solving and coding have allowed progress in the AI for Science paradigm, potentially replacing human roles in machine learning (ML) research. However, while several frameworks of fully autonomous end-to-end ML research have been proposed, successful implementations of them are often limited to problems with narrow search spaces, like language modeling or biomedical ML benchmarks. In this paper, we explore how autonomous research can be adapted to solve open-ended, industry-g…
items.why_zh: 它把自主 AI 研究从受控基准推向真实、开放式产业问题，检验该范式的实际边界。
items.why_en: It pushes autonomous AI research beyond controlled benchmarks into real, open-ended industry problems, testing the paradigm's practical limits.

items.title_zh: SoulAuth：面向人类与长期存续 AI 主体的 Actor 原生身份架构及 Rust 参考实现
items.title_en: SoulAuth: An Actor-native Identity Architecture and Rust Reference Implementation for Humans and Long-lived AI Actors
items.summary_zh: 随着 AI 系统从一次性的模型调用演变为跨越凭证、客户端、会话和运行时实例长期存续的“主体”，身份基础设施需要回答一个根本问题：身份连续性的权威边界应放在哪里。论文提出“Actor 原生身份”（Actor-native Identity）概念，并给出 SoulAuth——一个面向人类与长期存续 AI Actor 的开源 Rust 参考实现。作者主张，任何需要以自身身份持续存在并保持可独立归因的主体，都应拥有 ActorIdentity。该工作为多会话、多实例场景下的 AI 身份与追责问题提供了架构层面的思路和可运行代码。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11258v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As AI systems move from transient model invocations toward long-lived actors that persist across credentials, clients, sessions, and runtime instances, identity infrastructure must answer a basic question: where should the canonical continuity boundary be placed? This paper introduces Actor-native Identity and presents SoulAuth, an open-source Rust reference implementation for Humans and long-lived AIActors. We argue that any subject that must persist under its own identity and remain independently attributable should have an ActorIdentity that…
items.why_zh: 它为长期存续、跨会话运行的 AI 主体如何被唯一识别与归因提供了身份架构基础。
items.why_en: It offers an identity architecture for uniquely identifying and attributing long-lived, cross-session AI actors.

items.title_zh: 面向算法救济的“解释驱动”主动特征获取
items.title_en: Explanations-Driven Active Feature Acquisition for Algorithmic Recourse
items.summary_zh: 算法救济（algorithmic recourse）方法通常假设预测模型掌握个体的全部特征，但现实中特征获取成本高昂，决策往往基于部分信息做出。已有主动特征获取研究关注成本约束下的预测，却与解释脱节：解释往往在额外特征获取之后才给出，而不是用来指导获取哪些特征。该论文将算法救济与特征获取联合处理，反转了原有顺序，用解释来驱动特征采集。这有望在有限预算下更高效地给出可行的救济建议。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12179v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Algorithmic recourse methods typically assume that a predictive model has access to all features of an individual. In practice, decisions are often made with partial information, because features are costly to acquire. Active feature acquisition addresses cost-constrained prediction, but existing methods are explanation-agnostic: prior work provides explanations only after acquiring additional features, rather than using explanations to drive acquisition. This work flips that and treats algorithmic recourse and feature acquisition jointly. We u…
items.why_zh: 它把可解释性从“事后说明”变成“主动决策依据”，有望降低给出可行救济建议的成本。
items.why_en: It turns explainability from post-hoc description into a driver of acquisition, potentially lowering the cost of actionable recourse.

items.title_zh: 面向科学代码理解的检索增强生成系统
items.title_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Code Understanding
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型已成为现代编程助手的核心，但 Claude Code、Codex 等先进系统依赖体量巨大的云端模型，带来显著算力开销与数据隐私问题。该研究探索能否围绕小型开源模型构建一个完全本地运行、且足够实用的编码智能体，思路是把计算负担从推理阶段转移出去。作者开发了一个用于科学代码理解的检索增强生成（RAG）系统，严格分离昂贵的离线数据摄取与在线推理。该方法为在隐私敏感的科学计算场景中本地部署编码助手提供了可行路径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12190v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models have become central to modern coding assistants, but state-of-the-art systems such as Claude Code or Codex rely on very large, cloud-hosted models with significant computational cost and data-privacy implications. This work investigates whether a useful, fully local coding agent can be built around small open-source models by shifting the computational burden away from inference. We develop a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for scientific code understanding that strictly separates an expensive offline ingestion…
items.why_zh: 它探索用小型开源模型加 RAG 实现本地化编程助手，兼顾数据隐私与算力成本。
items.why_en: It explores fully local coding agents built on small open-source models plus RAG, addressing privacy and compute cost.

items.title_zh: RF-VoID：基于窄带射频表征学习的低带宽外墙瓷砖空鼓检测
items.title_en: RF-VoID: Towards Bandwidth-Efficient Exterior Tile Void Detection via Narrowband Radio-Frequency Representation Learning
items.summary_zh: 外墙瓷砖背后隐藏的脱粘（空鼓）是坠砖隐患，而毫米波雷达可提供非接触式检测手段。传统解读方式先重建距离剖面，其可靠性受限于可用带宽，而带宽恰恰决定了部署系统的成本、采集时间和监管负担。该研究因此提出一个问题：能否用计算来换取带宽。作者使用 4-40 GHz 步进频率系统扫描十二个含有 0.5-1.0 毫米空气空鼓的外墙试件。这项工作指向一种更省带宽的射频表征学习方法，以降低实际检测系统的部署门槛。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12388v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hidden debonding behind exterior ceramic tiles is a falling-tile hazard, and millimeter-wave radar offers a non-contact way to find it. Conventional interpretation first reconstructs a range profile, so its reliability is bounded by the available bandwidth, yet bandwidth is what sets the cost, the acquisition time, and the regulatory footprint of a deployed system. This work asks whether that bandwidth can be traded for computation. A 4-40 GHz stepped-frequency system scans twelve exterior-wall specimens containing 0.5-1.0 mm air voids at diffe…
items.why_zh: 它尝试以计算替代带宽，降低外墙空鼓雷达检测的成本与监管门槛。
items.why_en: It trades computation for bandwidth, potentially lowering the cost and regulatory burden of radar-based tile-void inspection.

items.title_zh: “我和你有什么不同？”：人类与 AI 生成代码质量差距的大规模基准评测
items.title_en: What is the Difference Between Me and You? Benchmarking the Quality Gap Between Human-Written and AI-Generated Code
items.summary_zh: AI 编程助手正成为生产软件的“共同作者”，但对其评估主要聚焦功能正确性，未回答一个关键问题：AI 代码在决定生命周期成本的质量维度上是否与人类代码不同。该研究进行了大规模比较，覆盖 Python、Java、C 三种语言共 787,562 个函数对：每个来自开源仓库的人类函数，都配以由三个 AI 助手（OpenAI GPT 系列模型、DeepSeek-Coder、Qwen2.5-Coder）依据其文档字符串生成的实现。作者据此刻画了人机代码在结构与质量上的差异，为评估 AI 编程助手的真实代价提供了新证据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12708v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI coding assistants are becoming co-authors of production software, yet their evaluation centers on functional correctness, leaving open whether their code differs from human code in the quality dimensions dominating lifecycle cost. We compare human-written and AI-generated code at scale: 787,562 function pairs across Python, Java, and C, each human function mined from open-source repositories paired with implementations generated from its docstring by three AI assistants (OpenAI GPT models, DeepSeek-Coder, Qwen2.5-Coder). We characterize stru…
items.why_zh: 它把 AI 代码评测从“能否跑通”扩展到影响长期维护成本的质量维度。
items.why_en: It broadens AI code evaluation from functional correctness to quality dimensions that drive long-term maintenance cost.

items.title_zh: UrduMMLU：面向乌尔都语理解的大规模多任务基准
items.title_en: UrduMMLU: A Massive Multitask Benchmark for Urdu Language Understanding
items.summary_zh: 有意义的多语言评测必须在目标语言和当地教育语境中检验模型。乌尔都语使用者超过 2.3 亿，却一直缺乏基于本土教育来源构建的 MMLU 式综合基准。作者提出 UrduMMLU，包含 26,389 道乌尔都语单选题，覆盖 26 个学科、五个领域，题目采集自本土乌尔都语题库和公开考试 PDF。与基于翻译的基准不同，UrduMMLU 将学科内容与乌尔都语及区域教育特有的内容结合起来，并对由考试材料衍生的部分进行了标注。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.07167v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Meaningful multilingual evaluation must test models in the target language and educational context. Urdu, spoken by more than 230 million people, lacks a broad MMLU-style benchmark built from native educational sources. We introduce UrduMMLU, a benchmark of 26,389 Urdu MCQs across 26 subjects and five domains, collected from native Urdu MCQ banks and public examination PDFs. Unlike translation-based benchmarks, UrduMMLU combines academic subjects with content specific to Urdu and regional education. We label the exam-derived portion thr…
items.why_zh: 它为覆盖 2.3 亿使用者的乌尔都语提供了源自本土教育材料的大规模评测基准。
items.why_en: It provides a large-scale benchmark for Urdu, spoken by 230M+ people, built from native educational sources rather than translation.

items.title_zh: FINESSE：面向多模态金融事件序列的智能体模拟器与基准数据集
items.title_en: FINESSE: An Agent-Based Simulator and Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Financial Event Sequences
items.summary_zh: 金融服务领域的机器学习研究受限于代表性开源数据集的稀缺。现有资源往往只聚焦单一模态或单一任务，难以反映金融业务中结构化、多模态、动态变化的本质特征。论文提出 FINESSE（金融事件序列模拟环境），一个基于智能体的模拟框架，用于生成由多个相互依赖事件流组成的合成结构化数据集。每个事件流对应不同的数据模态或来源，从而为金融 ML 研究提供更贴近真实场景的基准数据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11993v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning research in financial services is limited by the scarcity of representative open-source datasets. Existing resources are often narrowly focused on a single modality or task and fail to reflect the structured, multimodal, and dynamic nature inherent to many problems in financial services. In this paper, we introduce FINESSE, a Financial Event Sequence Simulation Environment, an agent-based simulation framework for generating synthetic, structured datasets composed of multiple interdependent event streams. Each stream corresponds t…
items.why_zh: 它用智能体仿真生成多模态金融事件数据，缓解该领域代表性开放数据集匮乏的问题。
items.why_en: It uses agent-based simulation to generate multimodal financial event data, easing the scarcity of representative open datasets in the field.

items.title_zh: 面向异构电信网络的差分隐私联邦近端优化客户流失预测框架
items.title_en: A Differentially Private Federated Proximal Optimization Framework for Customer Churn Prediction in Heterogeneous Federated Telecom Networks
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇 arXiv 新论文，聚焦电信行业的客户流失预测问题。作者指出，传统集中式机器学习需要把客户数据集中存放在中央存储库，既引发隐私担忧，也可能违反数据保护法规；联邦学习则允许多家电信运营商在不转移原始客户数据的前提下协同训练一个全局模型，从而缓解这一问题。但论文强调，现实中的客户数据往往是异构的（摘要在此处被截断），因此作者提出一种结合差分隐私与近端优化的联邦学习框架来应对异构场景。其意义在于为跨运营商的协作建模提供兼顾隐私保护和异构适应性的方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12470v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Customer churn is one of the major issues in the telecommunication industry. To predict customer churn, conventional centralized machine learning approaches have been widely used. This centralized approach requires customer data to be stored in a central repository, which raises privacy concerns and may violate data protection regulations. Federated learning addresses this problem by allowing multiple telecom operators to collaboratively train a global model without transferring their raw customer data. However, real-world customer data are often…
items.why_zh: 它为电信运营商在不共享原始客户数据的前提下协同建模提供了兼具隐私保障与异构适应性的可行路径。
items.why_en: It offers a practical way for telecom operators to collaborate on churn models without sharing raw customer data, combining privacy guarantees with robustness to heterogeneous data.

items.title_zh: 时间递归让模型可以用更少的层数
items.title_en: Temporal Recurrence Favors Fewer Layers
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文研究流式任务中的循环模型：这类模型可以跨时间携带隐式计算，使每一次更新都建立在先前产生的表示之上。作者由此提出一个基本问题——当时间递归已经在不同时间步之间提供了顺序计算后，每一步内部还需要多少深度？既有工作表明递归可以让浅层模型具备竞争力，而本文则把该问题视为算力分配问题，在多个算力预算下系统改变每步内的深度、专家宽度以及每层并行专家的数量进行对比研究。其价值在于为流式模型如何在时间维度与深度维度之间分配计算资源提供实证依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12531v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In streaming tasks, recurrent models can carry latent computation across time, allowing each update to build on representations produced earlier. This raises a basic question: once temporal recurrence provides sequential computation across steps, how much depth is still needed within each step? Prior work has shown that recurrence can make shallow models competitive. We instead study this question as a compute-allocation problem, varying within-step depth, expert width, and the number of parallel experts per layer across several compute budgets.…
items.why_zh: 它把“需要多少层”转化为算力如何在时间递归与网络深度之间分配的问题，为高效流式模型设计提供参考。
items.why_en: It reframes the depth question as compute allocation between temporal recurrence and network depth, informing more efficient streaming model design.

items.title_zh: 解码器余弦相似度在 SAE 特征流发现中为何失效
items.title_en: Where Decoder Cosine Similarity Fails for SAE Feature Flow Discovery
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文关注基础模型在微调、模型编辑与对齐过程中如何保留既有能力，认为理解支撑这些调整的内部计算对模型的持续演化日益重要。稀疏自编码器（SAE）能为残差流激活与子层输出提供可解释的特征字典，但状态特征与更新特征如何相互作用、进而形成下游残差特征，目前仍不清楚。作者据此指出，用解码器余弦相似度来发现 SAE 特征流存在失效之处，并对此展开分析。该工作有助于更准确地刻画模型更新过程中特征如何在内部流动与组合。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly adapted through fine-tuning, model editing, and alignment procedures while retaining previously acquired capabilities. Understanding the internal computations that support these adaptations is therefore becoming increasingly important for continual model evolution. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide interpretable feature dictionaries for residual-stream activations and sublayer outputs, but it remains unclear how state features and update features interact to produce downstream residual features. In this work, w…
items.why_zh: 它指出一种常用相似度指标在追踪 SAE 特征流时的局限，关系到能否正确理解模型微调与编辑的内部机制。
items.why_en: It exposes the limits of a common similarity metric for tracing SAE feature flow, which matters for correctly understanding how fine-tuning and editing change models internally.

items.title_zh: 边缘 AI 的电池代价：手机端大模型推理的环境影响研究
items.title_en: The Battery Price of edge AI: A study of the Environmental Impact of LLM Inference on Mobile Devices
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 交叉领域论文研究生成式 AI 向“本地优先”范式转移带来的代价。出于隐私、延迟与性能方面的顾虑，越来越多推理被放到用户设备而非远程云端执行，但这会给依赖电池的智能手机带来沉重计算负担，可能缩短续航并推高手机整体更换频率。论文对端侧大语言模型的能耗、性能与准确率进行了系统性研究，以评估这一范式在环境影响上的取舍。其结论对设备端 AI 的部署策略与可持续性讨论具有参考价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.11940v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative artificial intelligence raises privacy, latency, and performance concerns that motivate a shift toward "local-first" AI, where inferences are performed on the user's device instead of on remote cloud servers. This paradigm also places a significant computational load on battery-powered smartphones, potentially shortening battery life and increasing the overall replacement rate of mobile devices. This paper presents a systematic study of the energy consumption, performance, and accuracy of on-device large langua…
items.why_zh: 它把隐私与延迟驱动的端侧推理潮流，与手机能耗、电池寿命和电子设备更替的环境成本放在一起权衡。
items.why_en: It weighs the privacy- and latency-driven push to on-device inference against phone energy use, battery life, and the environmental cost of faster device turnover.

items.title_zh: 通过随机缩放为加速 sketch-and-project 牛顿法做推断
items.title_en: Inference for Newton Methods with Accelerated Sketch-and-Project via Random Scaling
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 交叉领域论文研究一种在线草图牛顿方法：每一步都用当前先进的草图求解器——广义加速 sketch-and-project 求解器（GAS）——来近似牛顿方向，从而缓解经典二阶方法的计算瓶颈。GAS 通过 Nesterov 动量更新实现加速收敛，相较朴素、未加速的 sketch-and-project 求解器更快，并支持灵活的投影度量，合理选择该度量还可进一步降低计算成本。作者在此基础上展开推断方面的研究。该工作有助于让二阶优化在大规模在线场景中更实用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.12421v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study an online sketched Newton method that approximates the Newton direction at each step via a state-of-the-art sketching solver, called the generalized accelerated sketch-and-project solver (GAS), thereby mitigating the computational bottleneck of classical second-order methods. The GAS solver improves upon vanilla, unaccelerated sketch-and-project solvers by achieving accelerated convergence through Nesterov momentum updates, and accommodates a flexible projection metric whose proper choice further reduces computational cost. Building on…
items.why_zh: 它试图在保留二阶方法优势的同时降低其计算开销，使大规模在线优化中的牛顿类方法更可行。
items.why_en: It aims to keep the benefits of second-order methods while cutting their cost, making Newton-type optimization more practical at large scale online.

items.title_zh: 低字符错误率并不够：视觉语言 OCR 在乌拉圭历史文献上的幻觉分析
items.title_en: When Low CER is Not Enough: An Analysis of Hallucinations in Vision-Language OCR Systems on Historical Uruguayan Documents
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 论文指出，OCR 是历史档案数字化的关键环节，而视觉语言模型（VLM）近来在标准基准上取得了领先表现，被视为传统 OCR 系统的有力替代。但作者认为，这类模型是否适合档案转录仍缺乏充分理解。为此，他们在 Berrutti 数据集上对传统 OCR 系统与基于 VLM 的方法进行了基准测试——该数据集由乌拉圭独裁时期文献的缩微胶片数字化而来，具有较高难度。研究特别关注幻觉问题，说明低字符错误率（CER）未必代表转录可靠。其意义在于提醒档案数字化场景不能只看常规指标。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.24077v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) is a key component in the digitization of historical archives. Recently, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have emerged as strong alternatives to traditional OCR systems, achieving state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks. However, their suitability for archival transcription remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we benchmark traditional OCR systems and VLM-based approaches on the Berrutti dataset, a challenging collection of Uruguayan dictatorship-era documents derived from microfil…
items.why_zh: 它说明在历史档案转录中，低字符错误率可能掩盖幻觉风险，评估 VLM OCR 不能只看常规指标。
items.why_en: It shows that low character error rates can mask hallucination risk, so VLM OCR for archives cannot be judged by standard metrics alone.

items.title_zh: 中国AI大模型调用量连续二十周领跑 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash上线三天升至第六
items.title_en: China's AI Model API Call Volume Leads for 20 Straight Weeks; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Rises to Sixth in Three Days
items.summary_zh: 中国AI大模型调用量连续二十周领跑 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash上线三天升至第六 Sohu
items.summary_en: According to Sohu, China's AI large-model API call volume has led for twenty consecutive weeks, and the newly launched DeepSeek V4.1 Flash climbed to sixth place just three days after release. The figures point to sustained heavy usage of domestic models and fast adoption of new releases.
items.why_zh: 连续二十周领跑与新品三天冲至第六，反映国产大模型使用规模与迭代竞争的双重活跃。
items.why_en: Twenty straight weeks at the top plus a three-day climb to sixth shows both the scale of domestic model usage and rapid iteration and competition.

items.title_zh: 智谱融资50亿美元承接商业化加速势能 上半年MaaS收入大增27倍
items.title_en: Zhipu Raises $5 Billion as H1 MaaS Revenue Jumps 27x
items.summary_zh: 智谱融资50亿美元承接商业化加速势能 上半年MaaS收入大增27倍 泰伯网
items.summary_en: Zhipu raised $5 billion to capitalize on accelerating commercialization, Taibo reported. Its H1 MaaS revenue surged 27x year-on-year, indicating strong enterprise demand. The funding will help Zhipu scale its model services further.
items.why_zh: MaaS收入27倍增长与50亿美元融资结合，说明智谱商业化正在提速，也验证大模型企业服务市场的潜力。

items.title_zh: 《汽车软件质量与缺陷管理规范》国家标准发布，将质量管控从事后处置转向缺陷预防
items.title_en: China Releases National Standard for Automotive Software Quality and Defect Management, Shifting Quality Control Toward Defect Prevention
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，市场监管总局（国家标准委）近日批准发布《汽车软件质量与缺陷管理规范》国家标准（GB/T 48140—2026）。 本次新国标发布有利于推动汽车软件缺陷识别与防控关口前移 ，进一步健全智能网联汽车软件安全治理体系，将从今年 12 月 1 日起实施。 IT之家了解到，当前“软件定义汽车”已经成为汽车行业发展趋势，软件在赋予汽车智能体验的同时，也带来新安全风险。软件缺陷多发态势叠加软件迭代升级常态化，对汽车软件质量与缺陷管理提出更加严格的体系化要求。 因此市场监管总局特此推出新标准，新规运用 PDCA 循环（策划 — 实施 — 检查 — 处置）和基于风险的思维，建立了覆盖汽车软件需求分析、设计实现、集成、验证确认、发布管理、升级与维护等全生命周期的车规级软件质量与缺陷管理规范，为汽车行业软件质量与缺陷管理提供统一遵循。 在质量策划方面，该标准要求汽车生产者、软件提供方及供应链上下游相关组织建立软件质量安全管理体系，实施软件安全管理、历史问题规避、状态报告监控等 10 项关键质量保证活动，适配多种开发模式，强化人工智能软件、嵌入式软件、云端软件等多类对象的管控要求。 在过程质量保证方面，该标准明确了汽车软件开发各环节实施质量保证活动的具体要求，将关键质量活动融入软件开发项目，确保各环节规范受控、软件产品符合规定要求，推动策划阶段确定的质量要求与开发活动同步落…
items.summary_en: China's market regulator approved the national standard GB/T 48140—2026 on automotive software quality and defect management, effective December 1. Using PDCA cycles and risk-based thinking, it defines full-lifecycle requirements from requirements analysis through release, upgrades, and maintenance, mandating a quality and safety management system and ten key quality assurance activities, with added controls for AI, embedded, and cloud software.
items.why_zh: 它把汽车软件质量管控从事后处置前移到缺陷预防，为“软件定义汽车”时代建立统一的车规级管理遵循。
items.why_en: It moves automotive software quality control from after-the-fact handling to defect prevention, giving the software-defined-vehicle era a unified compliance baseline.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，科技媒体 tweaktown 昨日（9 月 13 日）发布博文，报道称开发者 perseval_BLR 发布 NeuralScreen 应用， 可以将英伟达 DLSS 5 神经渲染应用于整个 Windows 11 桌面。 IT之家注：英伟达的 DLSS 5（Deep Learning Super Sampling 5）是该公司在 2026 年 3 月 GTC 大会上正式发布、并于同年 9 月随《NBA 2K27》上线的新一代 AI 图形技术。 与以往主要提升帧率的 DLSS 版本不同，DLSS 5 的核心突破在于引入实时神经渲染（Neural Rendering）模型，目的用生成式 AI 为游戏画面“补细节”，让光照、材质和皮肤等效果更接近好莱坞级别的照片级真实感。 目前英伟达 DLSS 5 仅在《NBA 2K27》游戏中官方上线，不过在该游戏发行前，相关.dll 文件已泄露，随后被 modders 广泛用于扩展至几乎任意游戏画面。 而本次介绍的 NeuralScreen 应用不再局限于游戏场景，可以针对 Windows 11 系统带来 DLSS 5 优化，但普通壁纸和文字通常不会有明显变化，主要变化体现在视频、图片和窗口化游戏画面上。 在视频和图片方面，通过这款非官方工具开启 DLSS 5 后，网页播放视频、照片等内容会经过神经渲染处理，进一步提高…
items.summary_en: Developer perseval_BLR released NeuralScreen, an unofficial app that applies Nvidia's DLSS 5 neural rendering across the Windows 11 desktop, per IT之家 and tweaktown. DLSS 5, Nvidia's new AI graphics tech, is officially available only in NBA 2K27, but leaked DLLs have already been used by modders elsewhere. NeuralScreen mainly affects video, images and windowed games, not plain wallpapers or text.
items.why_zh: 第三方工具把仅限单款游戏的神经渲染技术扩展到整个操作系统，展示了AI图形技术的扩散速度与版权/生态争议。
items.why_en: A third-party tool pushing a single-game neural rendering feature across an entire OS shows how fast AI graphics spread, along with the ecosystem and legal questions it raises.

items.summary_en: Sina Finance reports the consumer version of Doubao Phone Assistant is out, with the first phone carrying it going on sale September 16. The pairing marks ByteDance's AI assistant moving into hardware-bound consumer devices.
items.why_zh: AI助手与手机硬件绑定开售，是AI能力从软件走向终端入口的关键商业化尝试。
items.why_en: Bundling an AI assistant with phone hardware is a key commercialization step from software capability to device entry point.

items.summary_zh: AI训练数据公司获资本追捧，实习生创业团队估值25亿美元 虎嗅网
items.summary_en: Citing Huxiu, an AI training-data startup founded by interns has reached a $2.5 billion valuation amid strong investor interest. The case shows capital flowing to data services as high-quality training data becomes a key bottleneck for large models.
items.why_zh: 数据正成为大模型时代的稀缺资源，该估值表明数据供应链已站上资本风口。
items.why_en: Data is becoming a scarce resource in the LLM era, and this valuation shows the data supply chain is now a capital hotspot.

items.title_zh: 软银获119亿美元上调贷款，加码OpenAI投资
items.title_en: SoftBank gets upsized $11.9 billion loan in OpenAI funding push
items.summary_zh: 据《日本时报》报道，软银集团在一轮为投资 OpenAI 而进行的融资推进中获得一笔规模被上调的贷款，总额达到 119 亿美元。贷款规模扩大，显示软银正加大筹资本度以支撑其对 OpenAI 的资金投入。报道未披露该笔贷款的具体条款、期限与最终用途，相关融资安排的后续进展仍有待观察。
items.summary_en: SoftBank gets upsized $11.9 billion loan in OpenAI funding push The Japan Times
items.why_zh: 这笔贷款凸显软银在 OpenAI 融资版图中的关键角色，也牵动全球 AI 资本的供给与杠杆格局。
items.why_en: The loan underscores SoftBank's central role in financing OpenAI and highlights the leverage behind global AI capital flows.

items.title_zh: 豆包手机助手消费者版发布：GUI 合作协议同步推出，三方 App 可允许 / 拒绝 AI 自动化操作
items.title_en: Doubao Phone Assistant Consumer Edition Launches, With GUI Cooperation Pact Letting Third-Party Apps Allow or Refuse AI Automation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，豆包手机助手消费者版本今日正式发布。本次消费者版相比预览版更强调稳定性、日常可用性，并主打交互体验。 IT之家从官方新闻稿了解到，豆包手机助手支持语音、AI 键等多种唤醒方式，适配不同场景。其中专属 AI 键带有指纹鉴权能力，完成本人验证后无需二次解锁，即可调用助手执行相关任务。语音唤醒方面，豆包手机助手也针对远场、内噪和嘈杂环境等场景进行了优化。 本次豆包手机助手还新增了屏幕问答能力，用户无需额外截图或切换应用，即可让助手结合当前屏幕内容继续处理任务。以下是示例场景：用户打开相机对准室内环境，说出“根据这个装修风格，帮我选一个一米二以内、价格不超过一千元的柜子”，豆包可结合画面和要求，在电商平台找到符合条件的商品。 同时，豆包手机助手为本地数据提供了搜索工具，可以在用户需要时检索相册、短信、便签等信息。例如，当用户询问港澳通行证的到期时间时，助手可以从手机中的相关信息里找到答案。 除此之外，豆包手机助手还升级了录音体验，并接入飞书妙记能力。结合本地搜索工具，用户可以直接追问具体内容，如“昨天用户访谈里提到的产品建议”。用户还可以通过语音输入、三指上滑，或同时按住 AI 键和音量键等方式，手动保存当前屏幕内容，形成可在本地检索的记忆。 此外， 豆包手机助手本次将以 Beta 形式开放“操作手机”功能 。官方希望与合作伙伴共建开放、规范的手机 AI 应…
items.summary_en: Doubao's Phone Assistant has launched its consumer edition, emphasizing stability and everyday usability over the preview version. It supports voice and a physical AI key with fingerprint authentication, gains screen-based Q&A, and adds local search across photos, messages and notes plus upgraded recording with Feishu Miaojin. An "operate phone" feature opens in beta alongside a GUI cooperation agreement that lets third-party apps allow or refuse AI automation.
items.why_zh: 三方 App 可“允许或拒绝”AI 自动操作的框架，为手机端 AI 代理与既有应用生态的权责边界提供了可参照的治理样本。
items.why_en: A framework letting third-party apps allow or refuse AI automation offers a governance template for how phone-based AI agents coexist with existing app ecosystems.

items.title_zh: 豆包手机助手消费者版发布：GUI 合作协议同步推出，三方 App 可允许 / 拒绝 AI 自动化操作
items.title_en: Doubao Mobile Assistant Consumer Version Launches With GUI Cooperation Pact, Letting Third-Party Apps Allow or Refuse AI Automation
items.summary_zh: 豆包手机助手消费者版发布：GUI 合作协议同步推出，三方 App 可允许 / 拒绝 AI 自动化操作 新浪财经
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Doubao mobile assistant has released a consumer version alongside a GUI cooperation agreement, under which third-party apps can allow or refuse AI-driven automation of their interfaces. The framework aims to balance AI convenience with app makers' control. No list of participating apps or rollout schedule was disclosed.
items.why_zh: AI 直接操作手机 App 涉及权限与生态利益，豆包给出“可允许/可拒绝”的协商机制，可能成为此类代理式AI落地的参考规则。
items.why_en: When AI directly operates mobile apps, permissions and ecosystem interests are at stake; Doubao's allow-or-refuse mechanism could become a reference rule for agentic AI on phones.

items.why_en: Perspectives from a leading domestic model-maker offer an insider view of where Chinese AI is stuck and how it might break through.

items.title_zh: 马斯克：Grok 4.8 模型本周完成训练，参数量 2.5 万亿
items.title_en: Musk: Grok 4.8 to Finish Training This Week with 2.5 Trillion Parameters
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 14 日消息，xAI 首席执行官埃隆 · 马斯克今天在 X 平台透露， Grok 4.8 将是一款参数量达 2.5 万亿的 AI 模型 ，使用全新 C++ 软件栈训练。 马斯克表示， Grok 4.8 将在本周完成训练 、启动强化学习（RL）。 IT之家了解到，马斯克曾在此前表示，Grok 4.7 模型将于 9 月 12 日发布。但他随后表示， Grok 4.7 可能需要过几天才能正式推出 。延期原因可能是强化学习的回复长度惩罚过重，导致模型会过早放弃困难任务，而且不能严谨检查自己的工作。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk said on X that Grok 4.8 will have 2.5 trillion parameters and is being trained with a new C++ software stack, completing training this week before starting reinforcement learning. He had earlier said Grok 4.7 would launch on Sept 12 but later delayed it, possibly due to overly harsh response-length penalties in RL.
items.why_zh: 2.5 万亿参数与全新训练栈显示前沿模型规模仍在攀升，而 RL 调参问题也暴露了大模型训练中的现实难点。
items.why_en: A 2.5-trillion-parameter model and a new training stack show frontier scaling continues, while the RL tuning issue highlights practical challenges in large-model training.
